name: mirofish
description: MiroFish - 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && uv run --no-project --with-requirements requirements-test.txt pytest
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:backend:coverage && npm run test:frontend:coverage
scripts.test:backend:coverage: cd backend && uv run --no-project --with-requirements requirements-test.txt pytest --cov --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=html
